tips.startup: Supports {'{{VARIABLE}}'} placeholders substituted on server startup.

tips.configFrom: Only 1-hop inheritance within the same nest is allowed.
tips.configFromLocked: Other eggs inherit configuration from this egg; cannot set a parent.
